article_title: AWS Lambda Extends Timeout to 90 Minutes on Managed Instances, Six Times the Previous Limit

content_preview.title: AWS Lambda Extends Timeout to 90 Minutes on Managed Instances, Six Times the Previous Limit
content_preview.summary: AWS raised the maximum Lambda function timeout on Managed Instances to 90 minutes, up from 15, for async and event-driven invocations.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

AWS has extended the maximum execution timeout for AWS Lambda functions running on Lambda Managed Instances to 90 minutes, up from the previous 15-minute limit, according to a September 9 post on the [AWS Compute Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/announcing-90-minute-function-timeout-on-aws-lambda-managed-instances/). The new ceiling applies to asynchronous and event source mapping (ESM) invocations; synchronous invocations retain the existing 15-minute maximum timeout, acc...

Every claim in the article body was cross-checked against the snapshot text: (1) 90-minute timeout on Lambda Managed Instances, up from 15 minutes, for async/ESM invocations, synchronous invocations unchanged at 15 minutes - confirmed verbatim in source-0. (2) '6x increase' framing - confirmed verbatim in both source-0 ('This is a 6x increase from the previous 15-minute limit') and source-1 ('six times longer than the previous 15-minute limit'). (3) Timeout history 5 min (2014) to 15 min (2018) - confirmed in source-0. (4) Use-case list (media processing, financial calculations, data processing/ETL, AI inference, web scraping/large file transfer) - confirmed verbatim in both sources. (5) Graviton5-powered EC2 instance support and all-region availability - confirmed verbatim in source-1. (6) Idempotency quote ('Lambda does not guarantee exactly-once processing...') and retry-policy quote ('Lambda applies your configured retry policy (up to two retries by default)') - both confirmed verbatim in source-0. (7) Yan Cui quote, description as 'serverless expert and AWS Hero' - confirmed verbatim in source-1. (8) Rajesh Pandey quote and title 'principal engineer at AWS' - confirmed verbatim in source-1. (9) Dull_Caterpillar_642 quote - confirmed verbatim in source-1. (10) September 9 publication date attributed to AWS - confirmed via source-0 byline '09 SEP 2026'. No misattributions, no hallucinated quotes, no unsupported specifics found. Both source URLs appear in article.sources and are cited in the body (no orphan-source gap).
